description: CESNET-TLS-Year22: A year-spanning TLS network traffic dataset from backbone lines is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Karel Hynek et al. The modern approach for network traffic classification (TC), which is an important part of operating and securing networks, is to use machine learning (ML) models that are able to learn relationships between traffic characteristics and communicating applications. This requires representative datasets. However, datasets collected from real production networks are not being published in sufficient numbers. Coverage: not stated; published in 2024. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
